name: police_crime_london
title: Street-level crime, outcomes and stop & search for London (Metropolitan & City of London Police), Dec 2010 to present
description: Every crime and anti-social-behaviour incident recorded by London's two territorial police forces since December 2010, with case outcomes and stop & search records, as published on data.police.uk. Reconstructed as full history by combining data.police.uk's permanent monthly archive zips: a fixed covering set three years apart plus the newest zip, each month taken from the newest zip that contains it (the most-revised version). Three tables, one row per crime / outcome / stop, all columns strings exactly as published.

sources.title: data.police.uk — Archive downloads (Home Office; data supplied by the police forces of England, Wales and Northern Ireland)

update_cadence: data.police.uk publishes a new monthly archive zip roughly one to two months after the month it covers; the weekly pipeline run picks it up when it appears, so roughly one run in four detects changes and the rest report all files unchanged. Months inside the newest zip's ~36-month window are also revised by forces between releases, so recent history can change even when no new month has appeared.
caveats: Rows are incidents *recorded by* the Metropolitan Police Service and City of London Police, which together police Greater London — this is a force-based cut, not a geographic clip: a small number of incidents these forces handle fall outside London, and London incidents recorded by other forces are absent.
British Transport Police are excluded, so crime on London's railways and Underground is largely missing from these figures.

Locations are anonymised by data.police.uk: coordinates are snapped to a master list of over 750,000 map points (the `location` label reads 'On or near ...'), and are blank where no suitable point exists — never treat coordinates as exact offence locations.

Upstream revises months until they roll out of the newest archive zip's ~36-month window (forces re-upload corrections and reclassifications); months older than that are pinned to the version in the covering zip that contains them, so this history is the final published version of each month wherever one exists.

crime_id is data.police.uk's one-way hash, not a police reference number, and is empty for anti-social-behaviour rows; genuinely duplicate rows exist in the upstream files and are deliberately kept, so row counts match what upstream publishes.

Outcomes begin in January 2012 and stop & search in March 2015 for these two forces (the national collections started around 2014 and December 2014; London's published history differs), and neither is returned by every force for every month — gaps are upstream gaps, not fetch failures. One crime can have several outcome rows.
last_outcome_category on the crimes table is a snapshot as of the zip the month was taken from — use the outcomes table for outcome history.

No raw zip is republished (a deliberate exception to this repo's publish-the-raw-file rule): the inputs are ~9 GB of monthly zips that data.police.uk itself retains permanently at stable dated URLs — better provenance than a copy. catalog.json's fetched_from records the newest zip each build consumed.

resources.name: street_crimes
resources.description: One row per recorded crime or anti-social-behaviour incident, December 2010 to present. All columns strings exactly as published.

fields.name: crime_id
fields.description: data.police.uk's one-way hash of the record (64 hex chars) — not a police reference number; empty for anti-social-behaviour rows.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Month the crime was reported, YYYY-MM.

fields.name: reported_by
fields.description: Force that provided the data: 'Metropolitan Police Service' or 'City of London Police'.

fields.name: falls_within
fields.description: Force area the point falls within; currently always the same as reported_by.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Anonymised snap-point longitude (WGS84) as published; may be empty.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Anonymised snap-point latitude (WGS84) as published; may be empty.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Label of the anonymised map point, e.g. 'On or near Petrol Station'.

fields.name: lsoa_code
fields.description: 2011 Lower Layer Super Output Area code of the anonymised point; may be empty.

fields.name: lsoa_name
fields.description: 2011 LSOA name of the anonymised point; may be empty.

fields.name: crime_type
fields.description: data.police.uk crime category, e.g. 'Burglary', 'Anti-social behaviour'.

fields.name: last_outcome_category
fields.description: Most recent outcome at the time the month's zip was generated — a snapshot; see the outcomes table for history.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Free-text force annotation; almost always empty.

resources.name: outcomes
resources.description: One row per case outcome, from January 2012 onward. Joins to the crimes table via crime_id; one crime can have several outcome rows. All columns strings exactly as published.

fields.name: crime_id
fields.description: data.police.uk's one-way hash of the crime this outcome belongs to — joins to the crimes table.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Month of the outcome, YYYY-MM.

fields.name: reported_by
fields.description: Force that provided the data.

fields.name: falls_within
fields.description: Force area the point falls within; currently always the same as reported_by.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Anonymised snap-point longitude of the originating crime; may be empty.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Anonymised snap-point latitude of the originating crime; may be empty.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Label of the anonymised map point of the originating crime.

fields.name: lsoa_code
fields.description: 2011 LSOA code of the anonymised point; may be empty.

fields.name: lsoa_name
fields.description: 2011 LSOA name of the anonymised point; may be empty.

fields.name: outcome_type
fields.description: Outcome category, e.g. 'Investigation complete; no suspect identified'.

resources.name: stop_search
resources.description: One row per stop & search, from March 2015 onward. No force column exists upstream; force coverage gaps by month are upstream gaps. Boolean-ish fields are kept as the published strings ('True'/'False'/empty). All columns strings exactly as published.

fields.name: type
fields.description: 'Person search', 'Vehicle search' or 'Person and Vehicle search'.

fields.name: date
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the stop.

fields.name: part_of_a_policing_operation
fields.description: 'True'/'False'/empty — whether the stop was part of a policing operation.

fields.name: policing_operation
fields.description: Name of the policing operation; rarely populated.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Anonymised snap-point latitude; may be empty.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Anonymised snap-point longitude; may be empty.

fields.name: gender
fields.description: Gender of the person stopped, as recorded; may be empty.

fields.name: age_range
fields.description: Age band of the person stopped, e.g. '18-24'; may be empty.

fields.name: self_defined_ethnicity
fields.description: Ethnicity as described by the person stopped; may be empty.

fields.name: officer_defined_ethnicity
fields.description: Ethnicity as recorded by the officer; may be empty.

fields.name: legislation
fields.description: Legal power used, e.g. 'Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 (section 1)'.

fields.name: object_of_search
fields.description: What the officer was searching for, e.g. 'Controlled drugs'.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Outcome of the stop, e.g. 'A no further action disposal', 'Arrest'.

fields.name: outcome_linked_to_object_of_search
fields.description: 'True'/'False'/empty — whether the outcome related to what was searched for.

fields.name: removal_of_more_than_just_outer_clothing
fields.description: 'True'/'False'/empty — whether a more-than-outer-clothing search took place.
